title: Prime Minister shares glimpses of his visit to Varanasi
body_text: The Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has shared glimpses of various engagements during his visit to Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, highlighting the spectacular air show, the enthusiastic roadshow, and the region's strides in manufacturing and women empowerment. In a series of posts on X, the Prime Minister shared: “Varanasi air show…Magnificent!” Varanasi air show…Magnificent! https://t.co/nc1c5psdt8 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 25, 2026 “One of the best aspects of Arvind Limited’s garment manufacturing facility in Varanasi is the boost it will give to women empowerment!” One of the best aspects of Arvind Limited’s garment manufacturing facility in Varanasi is the boost it will give to women empowerment! https://t.co/nNSAuka9ne — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 25, 2026 “काशी में रोड शो के दौरान अपने परिवारजनों से मिले अपार स्नेह और आशीर्वाद ने भावविभोर कर दिया।” काशी में रोड शो के दौरान अपने परिवारजनों से मिले अपार स्नेह और आशीर्वाद ने भावविभोर कर दिया। https://t.co/SHKh89q1zU — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 25, 2026 “From Varanasi to the world!” From Varanasi to the world! https://t.co/llTOlnbU75 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) October 25, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/PRK
